gain_result.selection_rule: Actual1003ad40 first tablegain>=requested signedgain; both requests hit exact rows, not a shared quantization bin

limits: Asynchronous queue delivery and view execution are static routing evidence, not a runtime trace. UI/storage/allocation failures can prevent reaching start

No direct overwrite found on selected view-layout ->launcher start ->producer path. Generic UI/OS/filesystem helpers and every asynchronous background action were not recursively audited; no global no-overwrite theorem
Ordinary BLE start relies on existing GPIO mode selection rather than explicitly reapplying1002de28; gain is selected anew inproducer
Read aftersuccessfulSTART and beforeSTOP; recordtimes andrawresponses per item, noatomic six-field snapshot claim. Keep manualmode unchanged duringcapture

The registerread plan is justified by actual normal driver reads/RMWs, not independent silicon documentation. Inputreadback andADCfields do not identify physical mic, quantify acoustics, or prove DSPprocessing
No new mode-control command, RAMwrite, GPIOwrite, ADCwrite, ROMentry orfirmwareload authorized by this evidence
